claim: A pace window that reads line and frame serial needs them in step at the wrap; a window under a frame can use the line wrap alone.

evidence.text: A window that reads line + frame serial needs the two in step at the wrap; a window under a frame needs only the wrap. The mismatch read as 164 lines of false time per interrupt.
evidence.quote: A window that reads line + frame serial needs the two in step at the wrap; a window under a frame needs only the wrap.
